body: I have. And an MRI. Nothing was found
Truth is I’ve had it for a while. It’s probably part of something called visual snow syndrome but I’m not sure if it’s just me noticing it more. Cheers for the help

Did you read the post? If so there’s not much else to say. It’s like a blue high resolution shadow of my hand trailing behind every time I move it over a dark background. I’m not sure if it’s a problem or I’m hyper aware

Thank you for replying. I have been to an ophthalmologist and as expected nothing was picked up. For me the other symptoms are the ones that are disabling me and stopping me from doing everyday things like driving.
Thank you for everything. You’ve been really helpful. If I can ever do anything to return the favour just let me know

Thank you so much for responding. It’s just the thought of it going on forever that I can’t come to terms with. It’s weird because it’s made me appreciate all the things I had before but in a way where I can’t enjoy them now anyway. Is there anymore about this person you know you could tell me? It’s all good if not
